Priya: FYI PR #2142 preview on Vercel returns 404 for the JS example: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/54c9/examples/js/snippet.js
Ethan: Hmm I can open the preview front page but that direct asset 404s. Can you paste the page HTML path that references it?
Priya: The page HTML references `/examples/js/snippet.js?v=1623` but the Vercel assets list shows `examples/js/snippet.9b7a.js` (fingerprinted).
Zoe: That sounds like post-build fingerprinting moved/renamed files but didn't rewrite the HTML references. Did we enable a fingerprint plugin recently?
Priya: Our mkdocs config includes a tiny `asset-fingerprint` step in CI that runs after `mkdocs build` and renames files. I think the plugin should also rewrite links but our script only renames.
ci-bot: Vercel build 2024-03-11T09:12:03Z finished. Uploaded static files: 412. Static file size changed after post-process: 1 files renamed.
Ethan: Repro locally: `mkdocs build -d site && ls site/examples/js` shows `snippet.9b7a.js`. But the built `site/examples/index.html` still references `snippet.js`.
Zoe: Quick fix: update the fingerprint script to replace plain filenames in HTML, or disable fingerprinting for docs builds. Which do you prefer?
Priya: I'd prefer disabling fingerprinting in docs pipeline to keep previews stable. I'll push a tiny CI change to skip that plugin when `CI_DOCS=true`.
Ethan: If we disable, make sure production docs (hosted) still get cache-control headers; we rely on global caching.
Priya: Good call. I'll keep cache headers, just skip renaming. Pushing patch now (commit b2c7ea).
ci-bot: New deploy for branch docs/2142 started at 2024-03-11T09:24:11Z
Priya: Re-deployed preview link: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/54c9-2 — direct asset now 200. Verified in browser and curl.
Ethan: Looks good here too. Quick manual repro for reviewers: 1) `git checkout docs/2142` 2) `mkdocs build -d /tmp/site` 3) `python -m http.server --directory /tmp/site 8080` 4) visit `http://localhost:8080/examples/js/` and open `snippet.js`
Zoe: Thanks for the clear repro. Ethan & Zoe — can you review so Priya can merge before the docs merge window tonight?
Ethan: Reviewing now. Small nit in the CI script comment, but functionally fine. Approved.
Zoe: Approved.
Priya: Merging after checks. A reminder: this is a tooling-only change, no content change. I'll merge at 01:50 UTC so it doesn't conflict with the scheduled content roll at 02:00 UTC.
docs-bot: Reminder: Docs merge freeze begins at 02:00 UTC. Please avoid content merges in that window unless emergency.
Priya: Merged and closing. Will open a follow-up to add a unit test for the fingerprint step so we catch this in CI next time. :sparkles:
